comparison.objective: Back-butter a replacement tile, invert it, place it in a gap, and bed it level; candidate calibrates a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires trowel coverage, stabilizing and reorienting a tile, close placement, and pressing; candidate requires coaxial driver/wrench engagement and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Scores adhesive coverage, placement, squareness, lippage, bedding, tool release, and clearance; candidate scores angle, nut retention, repeated motion, drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Tool use is shared only generically; adhesive application and tile bedding test a different manipulation outcome.
